source.title: Systematic investigation of three-nucleon force effects in elastic scattering of polarized protons from deuterons at intermediate energies

source_uncertainty_note.point_to_point_construction: An extra error was added to each angular cross-section point until a high-order polynomial fit reached chi^2 approximately one; the paper attributes the excess scatter to target-thickness variation across angle/time on top of background-subtraction systematics.
source_uncertainty_note.analysis_boundary: The quoted 3% point-to-point value does not by itself identify independent Gaussian row nuisances or any other unique covariance model. Treat covariance assumptions as explicit model choices.
